description: Write field values of one object by field name, validated by the field types and all-or-nothing: when any value is invalid nothing is saved (400 cvrt_fields_invalid_values with per-field errors). Only fields of active groups located on the object can be written. Values are given as a form would submit them (gallery: array of image ids, select: value or array, true/false: 1/0). Returns the object's values as fields_get_values does (cvrt-fields 0.2.1+).

object.description: Object as ACF's post_id: a post ID ("42"), "term_5", "user_3", or the storage id of an options page ("options" for the default one)

values.description: Field name => value, e.g. { telephone: "06101 123456", open: 1 }

name: fields_update_values
